plan: Lane R1 (c-review-1005-1117) controls plan for the stage 4 review of issues #1005, #1006 and #1007: four packings in eight files, 4 x 51 + 4 x 34 = 340 controls. Written before any program of this lane read a certificate. Every outcome is stated as a rule over the certificate's own exact facts, since those facts were unknown when this was written; r1_controls.py evaluates each rule exactly and compares it with what both methods decide on the modified packing. A control is as stated only if, besides its rule, method A (r1_axes) and method B (r1_area) agree on every class of the decision it makes.

definitions.facts: n and the side S; method A's clearances L_k, B_k, R_k, T_k of square k at the left, bottom, right and top walls; method A's margin m_ij of each pair; W_left, W_bottom, W_right, W_top the least clearance at each wall; W = min(W_right, W_top); SIGMA = min(W_left + W_right, W_bottom + W_top), the side less the packing's larger extent; d = 10^-30.
definitions.contact and past: contact is a margin or a clearance of exactly 0; past is d beyond it, a margin or clearance of exactly -d.
definitions.the touching-wall branch: where W = 0 the certificate's squares touch its right or top wall: S1c is then the certificate itself, S1d is S1a, and the squares at the touched wall cross under any lowering of the side. Where W > 0 the side overstates the packing and S1a to S1d say by how much. The rules below cover both branches; the receipt records which one held.
definitions.whole-packing controls: the modified packing is written in the file's own form by this lane's writer, read back through the reader, required to equal the intended values exactly, and decided by both methods. Fully means every pair is decided afresh; patched means the pairs of two unchanged squares are carried from the certificate's decision, since a pair's margin and class are functions of its two squares alone, and every square and wall is decided again.
definitions.reasons: the decision's list of reasons for a refusal, in its order: not-unit, crossing, area-inside-below-1, overlapping, methods-disagree. 'Reasons exactly' means the list holds those entries and no other.
definitions.squares and pairs: squares are numbered from 1 by position in the file; pairs (i, j) have i < j.
definitions.tiers: each report's first file is decided and controlled in full (tier full: 51 controls): #1005's candidate, whose digest the issue states, and the three exact files of #1006 and #1007, which the issues say the author's two checkers read. The report's other file of the same packing (tier twin) is decided in full by r1_check.py and runs the 34 controls marked on_twins: the reading controls, the twin controls, the duplicate, the translated and the non-unit square, every side control, and the pair and single-square wall controls. The 17 controls that only repeat full decisions of the same squares (G4 to G10, W2, PALL, WALL) are run on the first file; control T0 is what says the twin holds the same squares exactly.
definitions.a refused certificate: the controls are run and reported whatever the certificate's verdict; most rules presuppose an accepted certificate and would then read as not stated.
definitions.the forms: a corners file lists four corners per square; a centre file gives a centre and a unit edge direction (cos, sin). Where a control differs between the forms both versions are stated.

controls.what: The closed form by centres and half-extents (r1_frame) recomputes every margin and every clearance of the certificate.
controls.stated: Equal to method A on every pair and every square, with no mismatch.

controls.what: The issue's claimed side against the certificate's side.
controls.stated: Prior: the claim is at least the side and is the side's 12-place ceiling. As stated when both hold.

controls.what: The report's other file of the same packing (its twin), read strictly and compared square by square as sets of four corners.
controls.stated: Prior: the same packing square for square: n equal, sides equal, the k-th squares' corner sets equal for every k.

controls.what: This file's packing with square 1 moved by (d, 0), compared with the twin.
controls.stated: Not the same packing; sides equal; the squares unequal in file order are exactly [1].

controls.what: The last square's entry deleted from the certificate's own text.
controls.stated: The reader refuses: n stated, n - 1 listed.

controls.what: The side rewritten as 2p/2q in the certificate's own text.
controls.stated: Read; n, the side and every square equal the certificate's; only the side is flagged as written out of lowest terms.

controls.what: Witness files: the second square's id replaced by the first's. Centre files: a fifth scalar appended to the first square.
controls.stated: The reader refuses: duplicate square ids; not an array of four scalars.

controls.what: The side written as the number 17.5 (a plain YAML scalar; a JSON number).
controls.stated: The reader refuses.

controls.what: The first scalar of the first square given a leading plus sign.
controls.stated: The reader refuses: not a rational scalar.

controls.what: A second side key, with the value S + 1, inserted directly after the first.
controls.stated: The reader refuses: duplicate key.

controls.what: The file's stated meaning changed. Witness files: origin lower-left replaced by container-center. Centre files: 'cos, sin]' replaced by 'sin, cos]' in the format sentence.
controls.stated: The reader refuses.

controls.what: Square n replaced by a copy of square 1. Fully decided.
controls.stated: REFUSE; reasons exactly overlapping [(1, n)]; that margin exactly -1 and method B's area exactly 1; for every 1 < k < n the margin of (k, n) equals the certificate's margin of (1, k).

controls.what: Square 1 translated by (S, 0). Fully decided.
controls.stated: REFUSE; reasons exactly crossing [(1, right)] and area-inside-below-1 [1]; square 1's right clearance exactly R_1 - S; its area inside the box exactly 0; no overlapping pair.

controls.what: Square 1 made not a unit square by d: in a corners file its first corner's x raised by d; in a centre file its cos raised by d. Fully decided.
controls.stated: REFUSE; reasons exactly not-unit [1]; refused as a unit square by method A and by method B.

controls.what: Corners files: every square listed in reverse. Centre files: every direction negated. Fully decided.
controls.stated: The certificate's verdict; every margin and every clearance equal to the certificate's; in a corners file every sense exchanged, in a centre file every sense unchanged.

controls.what: Corners files: every square listed from its second corner. Centre files: every direction turned a quarter, (cos, sin) to (-sin, cos). Fully decided.
controls.stated: The certificate's verdict; every margin, clearance and sense equal to the certificate's.

controls.what: Transposed: x and y exchanged in every corner, or in every centre and direction. Fully decided.
controls.stated: The certificate's verdict; every margin equal; clearances (L, B, R, T) become (B, L, T, R); in a corners file every sense exchanged, in a centre file unchanged.

controls.what: A quarter turn about the box centre: (x, y) to (S - y, x), directions (cos, sin) to (-sin, cos). Fully decided.
controls.stated: The certificate's verdict; every margin equal; clearances (L, B, R, T) become (T, L, B, R); every sense unchanged.

controls.what: Mirrored: x to S - x, directions (cos, sin) to (-cos, sin). Fully decided.
controls.stated: The certificate's verdict; every margin equal; clearances (L, B, R, T) become (R, B, L, T); in a corners file every sense exchanged, in a centre file unchanged.

controls.what: Contracted: every centre multiplied by 99/100, each square keeping its shape and tilt. Fully decided.
controls.stated: Every margin equals the closed form's on the contracted centres. Prior: REFUSE, with at least one overlapping pair. As stated when the margins agree and the verdict is REFUSE with an overlapping pair.

controls.what: Tilts erased: every square replaced by the upright unit square about its centre. Fully decided.
controls.stated: Every margin equals the closed form's on the upright squares. Prior: REFUSE, with at least one overlapping pair. As stated when the margins agree and the verdict is REFUSE with an overlapping pair.

controls.what: The side lowered by 1 (gross). Patched.
controls.stated: The side rule with lowering 1 (stated under S1a); REFUSE.

controls.what: The side lowered by d. Patched.
controls.stated: The side rule with lowering d: every right and top clearance lower by exactly the lowering, every left and bottom clearance and every margin unchanged; crossing exactly the (k, right) with R_k below the lowering and the (k, top) with T_k below it; REFUSE exactly when some square crosses. Prior: W = 0, so refused.

controls.what: The side lowered by 1/q, q the denominator of the side in lowest terms. Patched.
controls.stated: The side rule with lowering 1/q.

controls.what: The side lowered by W. Patched.
controls.stated: The side rule with lowering W; the certificate's verdict; a square at the right or top wall at clearance exactly 0.

controls.what: The side lowered by W + d. Patched.
controls.stated: The side rule with lowering W + d; REFUSE.

controls.what: The side set to the issue's claimed side C. Patched.
controls.stated: The side rule with lowering S - C (a raising when C is above S). Prior: accepted.

controls.what: The side set to C - 10^-12, the claim's 12-place floor. Patched.
controls.stated: The side rule with lowering S - C + 10^-12. Prior: refused.

controls.what: The packing's own extent: every square translated by (-W_left, -W_bottom) and the side set to S - SIGMA. Fully decided.
controls.stated: The certificate's verdict; every margin unchanged; clearances exactly (L - W_left, B - W_bottom, R + W_left - SIGMA, T + W_bottom - SIGMA); squares at clearance exactly 0 at the left wall, at the bottom wall, and at the right or the top wall.

controls.what: The same translation with the side S - SIGMA - d. Patched from S2c.
controls.stated: REFUSE; crossing exactly the squares whose right or top clearance in S2c is below d; every margin unchanged.

controls.what: The first pair, in (i, j) order, whose margin is exactly 0 and whose centres differ: square j moved along the centre line so that the closed form gives the margin -d. Patched.
controls.stated: REFUSE; (i, j) overlapping, its margin exactly -d by method A and by the closed form, overlapping by method B. Where no pair of the certificate touches, the control is recorded as having no subject.

controls.what: The first pair, in ascending order of (margin, i, j) over the pairs with a positive margin, with an eligible square: square j is tried first, then square i. A square is eligible when every other margin and every wall clearance of it is positive and exceeds the length of the shift that takes the pair d past contact. The eligible square is moved along the centre line to exact contact. Patched.
controls.stated: The certificate's verdict with no reason; that pair's margin exactly 0 by method A and by the closed form, touching by method B; one more touching pair than the certificate has. Where no pair has an eligible square, the tightest positive pair is closed by moving j and the outcome is stated only for that pair: margin exactly 0, touching by method B.

controls.what: The same pair and square, moved d past contact. Patched.
controls.stated: REFUSE; reasons exactly overlapping [(i, j)]; that margin exactly -d by method A and by the closed form; method B's area positive. In the fallback of P1c: REFUSE, with (i, j) among the overlapping pairs at margin exactly -d.

controls.what: The eligible square nearest the left wall (least clearance, then least index) moved to it. A square is eligible when every margin of it exceeds its clearance at the wall plus d. Patched.
controls.stated: The certificate's verdict with no reason; that square's clearance at the wall exactly 0 by method A, touching by method B; its clearance at the opposite wall raised by the move. Where no square is eligible the control is recorded as having no subject, and W2 stands for the wall.

controls.what: The same square moved d further. Patched.
controls.stated: REFUSE; reasons exactly crossing [(k, left)] and area-inside-below-1 [k]; that clearance exactly -d.

controls.what: As W1c-left, at the bottom wall.
controls.stated: As W1c-left, at the bottom wall.

controls.what: As W1p-left, at the bottom wall.
controls.stated: As W1p-left, at the bottom wall.

controls.what: As W1c-left, at the right wall.
controls.stated: As W1c-left, at the right wall.

controls.what: As W1p-left, at the right wall.
controls.stated: As W1p-left, at the right wall.

controls.what: As W1c-left, at the top wall.
controls.stated: As W1c-left, at the top wall.

controls.what: As W1p-left, at the top wall.
controls.stated: As W1p-left, at the top wall.

controls.what: The whole packing translated toward the left wall by W_left. Fully decided.
controls.stated: The certificate's verdict; every margin unchanged; every clearance at the wall lower by exactly W_left and at the opposite wall higher by it, the other two unchanged.

controls.what: The whole packing translated toward the left wall by W_left + d. Fully decided.
controls.stated: REFUSE; reasons exactly crossing, the (k, left) with L_k below W_left + d, and area-inside-below-1, the same squares; every margin unchanged.

controls.what: As W2c-left, at the bottom wall.
controls.stated: As W2c-left, at the bottom wall.

controls.what: As W2p-left, at the bottom wall.
controls.stated: As W2p-left, at the bottom wall.

controls.what: As W2c-left, at the right wall.
controls.stated: As W2c-left, at the right wall.

controls.what: As W2p-left, at the right wall.
controls.stated: As W2p-left, at the right wall.

controls.what: As W2c-left, at the top wall.
controls.stated: As W2c-left, at the top wall.

controls.what: As W2p-left, at the top wall.
controls.stated: As W2p-left, at the top wall.

controls.what: Every pair of the certificate, all n(n-1)/2, closed along its centre line: square j moved toward square i to exact contact and to d past it (pair-level; only the pair is decided).
controls.stated: At contact method A's margin, both ways round, and the closed form's are exactly 0 and method B says touching, both ways round; d past, they are exactly -d and method B says overlapping with a positive area, equal both ways round. Every pair has distinct centres, so every pair is closed.

controls.what: Every square moved to each of the four walls and d past it (square-level; only the square is decided).
controls.stated: At the wall method A's clearance is exactly 0, method B says touching and the area inside the box is exactly 1; d past, the clearance is exactly -d, method B says overlapping and the area inside is below 1. 4n moves to contact and 4n past.

priors: Each of the eight files is accepted by both methods.
Each claimed side is the 12-place ceiling of its certificate's side.
Each report's two files hold one packing square for square.
W = 0 in every file: the squares touch the right or the top wall, and the left and bottom walls, so SIGMA = 0 and the side is the packing's larger extent.
S1e is accepted and S1f refused in every file.
G9 and G10 are refused in each report's first file.
